library(PIFDataModel)

JSON Schema Example

Here is a sample JSON schema:

{
  "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#",
  "title": "Person",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "The person's name"
    },
    "age": {
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "The person's age",
      "minimum": 0
    }
  },
  "required": ["name", "age"]
}

After building the site, this will display syntax-highlighted JSON on your pkgdown site.

2. Embed JSON Viewer Library

Add a viewer like json-editor to the pkgdown website.

  1. Add a custom JavaScript file (inst/pkgdown/assets/json-viewer.js) to initialize the JSON editor:
   const schema = {
       "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#",
       "title": "Person",
       "type": "object",
       "properties": {
           "name": {
               "type": "string",
               "description": "The person's name"
           },
           "age": {
               "type": "integer",
               "description": "The person's age",
               "minimum": 0
           }
       },
       "required": ["name", "age"]
   };

   const editor = new JSONEditor(document.getElementById("editor"), { schema: schema });
library(jsonlite)
library(DiagrammeR)

# Parse JSON schema
json_schema <- '{
  "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#",
  "title": "Person",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "The person\'s name"
    },
    "age": {
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "The person\'s age",
      "minimum": 0
    }
  },
  "required": ["name", "age"]
}'

schema <- fromJSON(json_schema)

# Convert schema to a tree diagram
tree <- grViz("
digraph json_schema {
  graph [rankdir=LR]
  node [shape=box, style=filled, color=lightblue]
  'Schema' -> 'Properties'
  'Properties' -> 'name'
  'Properties' -> 'age'
  'name' -> 'string'
  'age' -> 'integer'
}")
